acceptance_criteria.description: The exact case, subject, provider, model, budget, metrics, image identities and command are frozen before execution.
Execution uses a fresh record root outside scratch-only .runs storage, with content-addressed artifacts retained durably.
The persisted exploratory observation report passes bmp-verify-report from retained bytes.
The outcome remains explicitly exploratory and is not presented as a leaderboard or claim-ready score.

objective: After infrastructure and activation prerequisites are satisfied, execute the checked-in exploratory Magenta smoke experiment for its single explicit fix-git case using a fresh durable record root; retain every official verifier and failure outcome without making a benchmark claim.
title: Run one Magenta Terminal-Bench exploratory pilot case
